title: In-Memory Risk Gateway
description: Adds gap-free Gateway validation replicas and authoritative sequenced BLP pre-trade risk while preserving the 009b input/output topology and accepted business contracts.

nodes.label: Authenticated Client
nodes.description: Submits idempotent order and market-trade commands.

nodes.label: Account Service
nodes.description: Owns account status and principal entitlements; exposes watermarked snapshot and versioned changes.

nodes.label: Reference Data
nodes.description: Owns numeric security identity and trading status; exposes watermarked snapshot and versioned changes.

nodes.label: Risk Administration
nodes.description: Owns authenticated, versioned limits, restrictions, kill switches, and audit provenance.

nodes.label: Durable Control Stream
nodes.description: Retained versioned deltas with replay, consumer position, high watermark, and gap recovery.

nodes.label: Gateway Replica Updater
nodes.description: Builds consistent local images with subscribe-buffer-snapshot-catch-up and controls readiness.

nodes.label: Gateway Local Screen
nodes.description: Fast local preliminary validation, normalization, and correlated submitted-command ingress.

nodes.label: Control Event Adapter
nodes.description: Converts validated source deltas to complete globally sequenced BLP control events.

nodes.label: Price Feed
nodes.description: Supplies sequenced price and source-time state inherited from 009b.

nodes.label: 009b Sequencer + Journal
nodes.description: Totally orders commands, controls, and prices and journals each before BLP processing.

nodes.label: BLP Risk + Matching
nodes.description: Authoritative single-writer decision, reservation, idempotency, position, and executable book state.

nodes.label: 009b Output Disruptor
nodes.description: Unchanged output handlers for responses, NATS fan-out, and read-model projection.

nodes.label: NATS Business Fan-Out
nodes.description: Existing accepted order, trade, and position realtime subjects.

nodes.label: Read-Model Projector
nodes.description: Existing asynchronous query projection; never admission authority.

nodes.label: Prometheus + Grafana
nodes.description: Replica readiness/lag/gaps, decision latency/reasons, mismatch, capacity, and inherited hot-path telemetry.
